---
title: "DoubletFinder"
output: html_notebook
---

LOAD LIBRARIES
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(scCustomize)
library(R.utils)
library(Matrix)
```

Per sample run: GSE183837_con1
```{r}
GSE183837_con1<-readRDS("<original_archive>/scRNA_GSE183837/RDS_files/GSE183837_con1.RDS")
GSE183837_con1$id <- "con1"
GSE183837_con1$sample <- "Control"
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(GSE183837_con1) <- "RNA"
DefaultLayer(GSE183837_con1[["RNA"]]) <- "counts"

```

```{r}
GSE183837_con1 <- NormalizeData(GSE183837_con1)
GSE183837_con1 <- FindVariableFeatures(GSE183837_con1, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
GSE183837_con1 <- ScaleData(GSE183837_con1)
GSE183837_con1 <- RunPCA(GSE183837_con1)
GSE183837_con1 <- RunUMAP(GSE183837_con1, dims = 1:15)
```

```{r}
sweep.res <- paramSweep(GSE183837_con1, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# View top pK (you can visualize or just print top rows)
head(bcmvn[order(bcmvn$BCmetric, decreasing = TRUE), ])

```

Determine the highest BCmetric to select optimal pK value
```{r, fig.width=12}
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(x = pK, y = BCmetric)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
# If you have clusters:
# annotations <- GSE183837_con1@meta.data$seurat_clusters
# homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
# If not clustered yet, set to 0:
homotypic.prop <- 0

nExp_poi <- round(0.05 * nrow(GSE183837_con1@meta.data))  # Adjust the rate if needed
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

```

Find doublets
```{r}
GSE183837_con1 <- doubletFinder(
  GSE183837_con1,
  PCs = 1:10,
  pN = 0.25,
  pK = 0.29,
  nExp = nExp_poi,
  reuse.pANN = NULL,
  sct = FALSE
)

# Second round with adjusted expected doublets
GSE183837_con1 <- doubletFinder(
  GSE183837_con1,
  PCs = 1:10,
  pN = 0.25,
  pK = 0.29,
  nExp = nExp_poi.adj,
  reuse.pANN = paste0("pANN_0.25_0.29_", nExp_poi),
  sct = FALSE
)

```

Remove doublets
```{r}
# Set the name of your doublet classification column
doublet_col <- "DF.classifications_0.25_0.29_364"

# Get the names of singlet cells
singlet_cells <- rownames(GSE183837_con1@meta.data)[
  GSE183837_con1@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet"
]

# Subset manually using cell names
GSE183837_con1_singlets <- subset(GSE183837_con1, cells = singlet_cells)

saveRDS(GSE183837_con1_singlets, "GSE183837_con1_singlets_july9.rds")

```

  features = "pANN_score",
  pt.size = 0.1
)

```{r, fig.width=15}
con2_504 <- readRDS("<original_archive>/scRNA_PRJNA1141235/RDS_files/SRR30016504.RDS")
con2_504$id <- "con2_504"
con2_504$sample <- "Control"

DefaultAssay(con2_504) <- "RNA"
DefaultLayer(con2_504[["RNA"]]) <- "counts"

con2_504 <- NormalizeData(con2_504)
con2_504 <- FindVariableFeatures(con2_504)
con2_504 <- ScaleData(con2_504)
con2_504 <- RunPCA(con2_504)

sweep.res <- paramSweep(con2_504, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

ggplot(bcmvn, aes(x = pK, y = BCmetric)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

homotypic.prop <- 0
nExp_poi <- round(0.05 * nrow(con2_504@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

con2_504 <- doubletFinder(con2_504, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.3, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = NULL, sct = FALSE)
con2_504 <- doubletFinder(con2_504, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.3, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = paste0("pANN_0.25_0.3_", nExp_poi), sct = FALSE)

doublet_col <- paste0("DF.classifications_0.25_0.3_", nExp_poi.adj)
singlet_cells <- rownames(con2_504@meta.data)[con2_504@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet"]
con2_504_singlets <- subset(con2_504, cells = singlet_cells)

saveRDS(con2_504_singlets, "con2_504_singlets_july9.rds")

```
